name: IndicXNLI: Natural Language Inference for Indic Languages
description: IndicXNLI is a natural language inference benchmark covering 11 major Indic languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu) as part of the IndicGLUE benchmark. It contains human-translated cross-lingual NLI test sets (2,247 test examples per language, totaling 24,717 test instances) and machine-translated training data (392,702 examples per language) aligned with XNLI premises and hypotheses to evaluate cross-lingual sentence comprehension.
